cards.title: Game room
cards.rule.mauBinh: 2–4 players, 13 cards each split into 3 hands (3-5-5), compared hand by hand against each player; wrong order means a foul hand.

mb.arrange: Tap cards to place them: Hand 3 (strongest) first, then Hand 2, Hand 1. Tap a placed card to take it back. Hand 1 ≤ Hand 2 ≤ Hand 3, then press Done.
mb.lung: Each hand must be at least as strong as the one before. This is a foul hand: you lose all three!
cards.label: Game room
cards.rule.tienLen: 2–4 players, 13 cards each, first to empty their hand wins. Losers pay per card left (double if stuck with all 13); four of a kind and pair runs can chop 2s.
tl.firstMove: you lead and must include the lowest card (3♠ if held)
tl.invalid: These cards don't make a valid combination
cards.rule.xiDach: The host is the dealer; players compete against the dealer. Closest to 21 wins, over 21 busts. Two aces, five-card 21 and ace + ten pay more.
xd.yourTurn: 🎯 Your turn: Hit or Stand (players need 16+ to stand)
xd.waitOthers: You stood, waiting for the others…
xd.needMin: You need at least {n} points to stand
cards.rule.phom: 2–4 players, 9 cards each. Each turn draw or take the previous player's discard (if it makes a meld), then discard. After 4 discards cards are laid down: fewest leftover points wins; going out (all melds) pays big.
phom.drawTurn: 🎯 Step 1/2: Draw from the deck, or take the previous discard
phom.discardTurn: 🎯 Step 2/2: Pick a card (a leftover) and press Discard
tl.leadHint: play any combination: pick cards then Play (or 💡 Hint)
tl.beatHint: beat {name}'s {kind} with a higher one, or Pass
phom.canEat: {name}'s {card} can be taken: it makes a meld!
